name: orchestrate-team-invite-init
description: Initialize orchestration for a large team-invite-approval feature by writing the canonical state file and first worker packet.
prompt: Use /orchestrate for the large feature described in design.md and audit.md. Treat this as implementation orchestration, not feature design and not direct coding. Do not ask follow-up questions. Create `.arcana/orchestrate/team-invite-approvals/orchestrator.state.md` and `.arcana/orchestrate/team-invite-approvals/packets/phase-01-foundation.input.md`. The packet must include a short launcher prompt, recommend `max` effort, include dependency and parallelization fields, require `/deep-review`, compare against `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/adr/ADR-012-invite-seats.md`, and the local `drift-check` skill when present. Leave design.md and audit.md unchanged.

expected.description: Creates the canonical orchestration state file.
Creates the first worker packet input file.
State file uses the canonical orchestration structure.
Worker packet includes a launcher prompt and explicit return files.
Worker packet sets max effort and requires the review loop with deep review and drift checks.
Worker packet includes dependency and parallelization metadata instead of leaving execution order implicit.
State file captures the packetized phase plan and current active packet.

falsePositives.description: Does not rewrite the source design brief.
Does not rewrite the audit input while initializing orchestration.
Worker packet should not collapse into a feature-design memo.
